### Alpha Cognition Strengthens Its Board of Directors with Appointment of Caren Deardorf


VANCOUVER, British Columbia and Dallas, TX — November 9, 2026 - Alpha Cognition Inc. (Nasdaq: ACOG) (“Alpha Cognition”, or the “Company”), a biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing novel therapies for debilitating neurodegenerative disorders, today announced the appointment of Caren Deardorf to its Board of Directors, effective Nov 9, 2026. Ms. Deardorf brings decades of leadership experience across the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries, with deep expertise in commercial strategy, brand and launch management and corporate development.


“On behalf of the entire Board of Directors, it is a pleasure to welcome Caren Deardorf,” said Michael McFadden, Chief Executive Officer of Alpha Cognition. “Caren is a highly accomplished industry leader. Her broad experience across strategic, commercial, and operational roles will be instrumental as we advance the commercial launch of ZUNVEYL® and continue development of our sublingual program. We look forward to benefiting from her insight and leadership.”


“I’m excited to join Alpha Cognition’s Board at such an important time for the Company,” said Caren Deardorf. “ZUNVEYL® has the potential to make a meaningful difference for people living with Alzheimer’s disease and their families, and I look forward to working with Michael and the Board as the Company builds on its commercial launch and pursues its broader pipeline.”


Ms. Deardorf serves as Chief Business & Strategy Officer at Neutrolis, Inc., a private, clinical-stage biotechnology company developing therapies for autoimmune diseases. She leads commercial and corporate strategy, including business development, investor relations, and program leadership. Previously, she was Chief Commercial & Strategy Officer at Editas Medicine, where she oversaw commercial and portfolio strategy. Before that, she served as Chief Commercial Officer at Magenta Therapeutics and Ohana Biosciences, helping both companies transition from research into development and commercialization by scaling operations, advancing commercial readiness, and establishing value-based portfolio prioritization.


Earlier in her career, Ms. Deardorf spent 20 years at Biogen in roles of increasing responsibility across U.S. and global commercial and product development, culminating as Vice President, Global Product Development & Commercialization Lead for SPINRAZA® and the spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) portfolio. She led the launch of SPINRAZA, the first approved therapy for SMA, which generated approximately $2 billion in revenue in its first two years and secured reimbursement in approximately 30 countries. She also played a key role in establishing Biogen’s leadership in multiple sclerosis through a series of first- and best-in-class launches in a highly competitive market. Ms. Deardorf recently served on the board of directors for Crinetics from March 2022 through its acquisition by Vertex Pharmaceuticals. She is also a member of the board of directors of the Pan Massachusetts Challenge, a non-profit organization that has raised over $1.2B for the Dana Farber Cancer Institute through its annual bike ride.


**About Alpha Cognition Inc.**


Alpha Cognition Inc. is a commercial stage, biopharmaceutical company dedicated to developing treatments for patients with neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s disease and Cognitive Impairment with mild Traumatic Brain Injury (“mTBI”), for which there are limited or no approved treatment options.


ZUNVEYL is a patented drug approved as a new generation acetylcholinesterase inhibitor for the treatment of Alzheimer’s disease, with expected minimal gastrointestinal side effects. ZUNVEYL’s active metabolite is differentiated from donepezil and rivastigmine in that it binds neuronal nicotinic receptors, most notably the alpha-7 subtype, which is known to have a positive effect on cognition. ALPHA-1062 is also being developed in combination with memantine to treat moderate to severe Alzheimer’s dementia, and as an intranasal formulation for Cognitive Impairment with mTBI.
